text:
Alex (Marketing): Hey team :wave: Quick sync — planning to publish the release announcement tomorrow at 10:00 PT. Need final changelog link + prod docs URL + canary window. Who can confirm timing and owners?

Sam (Eng): We can freeze the changelog by 6:00 PM PT today. I'll paste the final bullets shortly. @Rachel can you confirm docs timing?

Rachel (Docs): Docs are on staging now: https://docs.staging.redwood.ai/release/v2.2. I'll push the prod href after QA at ~7:00 PM PT. One tiny wording tweak in the autoscale paragraph (fixing passive -> passive/active sentence).

Sam (Eng): changelog snippet (will PR to main at 6pm):
```
- Added adaptive batching policy (beta)
- Improved KV cache hit tracking and telemetry
- Fixed skip-token bug in streaming responses
- Various perf tweaks for small-batch latency
```

Alex (Marketing): Nice — we'll keep the public post high-level and link to the full changelog for details. Also planning a short webinar next Tue 11:00 AM PT to demo the feature. Need speaker list, one-slide summary, and inbound-lead routing details.

Tom (SRE): Canary window confirmed: 10:00-11:00 PT tomorrow on dedicated-us-west. I'll be monitoring heatmaps and tail latency. Deploy scheduled from canary to prod after smoke passes.

ci-bot: Release pipeline queued — build 12345. Staging deploy at 09:30 PT, prod promotion at 09:50 PT. https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/12345

Rachel (Docs): I'll prep the one-slide summary and update captions. Will push prod docs link by 7:15 PM PT and paste here. For lead routing, recommend tag 'webinar-interest' routed to sales webhook + ops copy.

Alex (Marketing): Ownership plan: Sam — tech questions & changelog PR, Rachel — docs & slide, Nadia — inbound lead routing + lead form. @Nadia can you confirm you can set up webhook and Salesforce mapping (source:webinar-v2.2)?

Nadia (Sales): Confirmed. I'll create the Typeform + webhook and map to SFDC with source:webinar-v2.2. Will share the webhook url and mapping by EOD.

Sam (Eng): Will merge changelog PR at 6pm and tag v2.2. Also please confirm if there's an embargo — should we hold off outreach?

Alex (Marketing): No formal embargo for this one. Soft launch — we'll post and DM key partners. Webinar sign-up page will go live with the announcement.

Tom (SRE): I'll be on-call for the rollout window. Ping me if error rate >3% or 5xx spike.

Alex (Marketing): Awesome — thanks everyone. Final checklist: changelog PR merged by 6pm (Sam), prod docs link posted by 7:15pm (Rachel), canary + deploy ops ready (Tom), lead form/webhook (Nadia), marketing assets scheduled for 10:00 PT. I'll post the public copy in #marketing at T-30min. :rocket:

Sam (Eng): Sounds good — will paste PR link when merged.

Rachel (Docs): Will post prod docs URL here once live.

Nadia (Sales): Will post webhook + SF mapping here when done.

Alex (Marketing): Thanks — closing loop once PR + docs + webhook all in thread.
